summary: As an administrator, promote an existing user from Team
description:
As an administrator, I want to promote an eligible existing user from Team so that they can manage users, invitations, and application-wide audit records after signing in again.

Owner role: Engineering
Status: Proposed / not started
Implementation plan: ../../docs/plans/administrator-promotion.md
Depends on: None
Estimate: 72 person-hours across child tasks. Sum Task hrs only. This row adds no effort.
acceptance_criteria:
- Only an active administrator with valid CSRF can promote an active verified account. Local-password targets require a password hash, while trusted-header targets do not.
- Make administrator opens a confirmation naming the account and explaining the permissions and required fresh sign-in. Cancellation submits nothing.
- The transaction preserves all memberships and account fields, adds administrator once, increments the target security version once, revokes target sessions, and records admin.user.roles_changed with before/after roles and request metadata.
- Duplicate/already-administrator requests cause no additional audit, revocation, or version increment. Invalid and stale requests leave data unchanged.
- Old target browser, bearer, and refresh credentials fail after commit. Fresh sign-in grants administrator access in local-password and trusted-header modes. Actor sessions survive.
- PostgreSQL NO KEY UPDATE locks and real SQLite write serialization pass deterministic refresh/audit, session-issuance, duplicate-promotion, and disable-race tests without partial mutations.
- Expected failures appear and receive focus inside the open dialog. Global failures expose focused feedback, expired sessions redirect, and network failures display outcome uncertainty without automatic retry.
- HTMX and ordinary forms preserve search, filter, pagination, and mounted URLs. Keyboard and narrow-screen behavior work, and prior administration flows remain compatible.
- The user guide and named acceptance evidence are updated and applicable repository checks pass.

summary: Data Mover: Serialize promotion on PostgreSQL and SQLite

Acquire a real SQLite write lock before authoritative rechecks. Map lock and snapshot conflicts after rollback. Include SQL-generation and focused persistence tests.
